name: Survey tile in Capricornus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.7 degrees north of the ecliptic in Capricornus, imaged by SPHEREx 23 times in 12 visits over 39 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 48 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 39 hours starting 2026-05-02, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.70 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
